title: Unit Event — Time to Take Off! — Episode7 I Want to Understand

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD are just about ready to visit the US, where they'll attend the event Taiga and Ken are taking part in. An excited Toya is packing his things when he receives an unexpected message...

rows.Line: New York Academy of Music

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, I wasn't expecting to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also a bit surprised.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Mr. Lloyd?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “In your opinion, what kind of student was my dad?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “What kind of student was he? Well...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Like I said a second ago, he was basically a monk.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Oh, but also very stubborn.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uhh... I didn't catch that last part.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. He was apparently very stubborn.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Yes, I can kind of see that!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Based on what you've told us about him, Toya, he's as hard-headed as they get.

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Haha. To be fair, I'm not one to talk.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “When it comes to music, there are certain things in which I'm not willing to compromise.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Harumichi was a musician I respected very much. I feel like I learned something every time we played together.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Every time you played together...?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Yes, we swapped genres from time to time, and even played completely random music.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Each time I stepped out of my area of expertise, I was given a chance to objectively assess my playing abilities.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Not only that, I learned new ways of expressing myself through my music.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“I see...
That does sound like a good way to learn.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it's also easier said than done.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When I first started singing street music, my habits from playing classical music hindered me quite a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad and Mr. Lloyd probably had no issue dipping their feet in other genres because they were both great musicians already.)

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “So, Toya, since you and your friends are here, would you all like to give it a try?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Give what a try...?

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Ah, perfect.
I see some students doing a session in the courtyard.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Hey!”

rows.Speaker: Student Ａ
rows.Line: “Hm? Is Professor Lloyd telling us to come over?”

rows.Speaker: Student Ｂ
rows.Line: “Do you think that group's here to visit the school?”
se_walk_men_003_4

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Were you all just having a session?”

rows.Speaker: Student Ａ
rows.Line: “Yes, we're done with our morning classes, so we decided to do one for fun.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(A violin, a cello and a saxophone...
As far as sessions go, that seems like a standard combination of instruments, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, I've never seen some of these instruments before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... Oh, what do you think that silver pan is called?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I believe it's a steelpan.
I remember seeing it in a book once.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're apparently made out of steel drums, and you can produce different sounds depending on where you strike it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm having trouble imagining how we're gonna have a session using all these instruments...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But Mr. Lloyd just asked if we'd like to give this a try.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Would you all mind letting these kids play with you? They'll be singing.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Student Ｂ
rows.Line: “We don't mind.”

rows.Speaker: Student Ｃ
rows.Line: “That's perfect, since there aren't any vocalists around today.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Umm... Singing with them does sound fun...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But completely on the fly...? Is that gonna be possible for us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Yes, we aren't just dealing with street music here. We have a blend of genres...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I honestly can't imagine what our performance is going to sound like...)

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Harumichi used to participate in these sorts of sessions back in the day.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
“Is that true?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Yes. When I first met him, he always had this serious and curmudgeonly expression on his face.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “But after he played in one of these sessions, I saw him smile for the first time. He seemed to genuinely enjoy himself.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Dad? Having fun...?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Yes, it was quite a surprise.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (To think these sessions could hold that kind of power...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If there's anything our trip to the United States has taught me so far, it's that I still know very little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not just talking about the things I missed out on when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I dreamed of playing like my dad...
But it's clear now that I knew nothing about the truth behind his music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Which is why I want to know more.
I want to participate in this session and try to experience what he did...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to know how his music evolved.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, why not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We came all this way to America, so we should be making the most of every opportunity we get.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right! And this session is sure to help us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's give it a try, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.
